newsitem.title: LATVIA: BRASA SEEN QUOTED AGAIN AFTER Q2-BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: BRASA SEEN QUOTED AGAIN AFTER Q2-BOURSE.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Friday that it expects Brasa furiniture maker Brasa to be quoted again after good second quarter results and debt capitalisation.
Brasa, a secondary list stock with a 1996 balance sheet total of 770,182 lats, was suspended on May 15 because its own capital was negative.

"Of course the company has to capitalise some 300,000 lats of tax debts before that, but the most important thing for the Brasa management is to make the company work profitably," the bourse president Uldis Cerps told a press conference.
Brasa ealrier reported 1996 loss of 555,652 lats on net turnover of 684,695 lats.
"I hope that the second quarter results will be convincing," Cerps added.
